subject: Hosted API: Renewal + Commit Acceleration for VelociCart
messages:
From: Claire Benton <claire@velocicart.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@velocicart.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API renewal + capacity increase request

Hi Mateo,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal for Hosted API is coming up on 2026-11-15 and usage has grown faster than our forecast — we’re seeing sustained increases for cart personalization and search reranking. We’d like to accelerate our monthly committed tokens from 1.2B to 4.8B (4x) for the next 12 months, and confirm higher per-route rate limits for our ingestion pipeline (need sustained 1k req/s on the /generate route during peak).

Could you share:
- a proposed amendment with updated pricing and effective date aligned to our renewal (11/15)
- confirmation on soft-burst behavior and temporary burst pool access during ramp
- any volume discounts or staged ramp pricing you can offer

I’ve attached our Aug–Sep usage export for context (velocicart_usage_aug-sep2026.csv) and looped in procurement for contract handling.

Timeline: procurement needs a commercial draft by 10/22 to keep legal on schedule.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call if easier.

—Claire Benton
Head of Data Products
VelociCart
 claire@velocicart.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Benton <claire@velocicart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal + capacity increase request

Thanks Claire — appreciate the usage export, that helps. I’ve put Kimberly (pricing) and Karthik (ops) on copy so we can move quickly. High level plan from our side:

1) Pricing & commercial: Kimberly will share a draft amendment with tiered commit pricing plus a staged ramp discount.
2) Ops & SLOs: Karthik will confirm sustained rate limits, burst access window and any additional guardrails (softband).
3) Contract flow: we’ll provide a clean amendment for procurement by 10/22 and a DocuSign link once we agree terms.

To help speed things up: can you confirm whether the 1k req/s requirement is 1k concurrent on /generate or 1k new requests/sec? Also, are there particular regions (us-west/us-east) where the peak traffic is concentrated?

I’m free for a 30m sync tomorrow afternoon if you prefer.

—Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Benton <claire@velocicart.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal + capacity increase request — draft commercial

Claire / team,

Attached is a first-pass commercial amendment (proposed_amendment_v2.pdf) and the summary below. This is intentionally conservative on price per committed token and includes a staged ramp discount to ease cashflow during the first 3 months.

Summary (proposed):
- Term: 12 months, effective 2026-11-15 through 2027-11-14
- New monthly committed tokens: 4.8B (previous: 1.2B)
- Unit pricing: $0.00018 per prompt token / $0.00009 per completion token (blended effective rate shown in amendment)
- Volume discount: 8% off unit rates months 4–12 if usage >= 85% of commit for two consecutive months
- Softband & burst: included 15% softband above commit without overage charges for first 60 days; bursts beyond softband bill at overage rate (see amendment)
- Early payment / multi-year incentive: additional 3% credit if annual prepay is selected

We can adjust the staged ramping (e.g., month-by-month commit ladder) if VelociCart prefers smoother increases. My ask: if you can confirm acceptance in principle by 10/20 we’ll produce a DocuSign-ready amendment by 10/22.

Attachment: proposed_amendment_v2.pdf (redline-ready)

—Kimberly Park
Head of Sales — MidMarket
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Benton <claire@velocicart.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal + capacity increase request — ops notes

Hi Claire — quick ops notes and constraints so the amendment reflects what we can deliver reliably: 

- Rate limits: we can guarantee sustained 1k new requests/sec on /generate in us-west-2 with the 4.8B commit and a dedicated routing policy. If traffic is bursty across regions we recommend routing by region to avoid cross-region tail latency.
- Softband behavior: softband = 15% above commit with no immediate throttle; once softband is exceeded for >10 consecutive minutes we apply progressive soft-throttling (graceful degrade by reducing allowed concurrent prefixes). This is to protect KV cache hit ratios.
- Burst pool: we can provide a temporary 14-day burst pool (up to an additional 600M tokens) during ramp with prior notice. We’ll enable it the day you flip the commitment and run a controlled warm-up.
- Migration checklist highlights: prefix caching warm-up, client-side retry backoff (recommended jitter), and per-route tokenization sanity checks. I’ve attached the ops checklist (ops_burst_checklist.xlsx) for your infra/eng teams.

Let us know if you require a longer burst window or a larger burst pool — we can discuss tradeoffs vs pricing.

—Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Benton <claire@velocicart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@velocicart.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: Renewal + Commit Acceleration for VelociCart

Claire — great, really appreciate the quick turn.

On behalf of Redwood: we’re aligned with the proposed amendment and the ops plan above. Next steps I’m putting in motion:
1) Kimberly will finalize the DocuSign amendment (target: 10/22 EOD). DocuSign link will be posted in HubSpot and emailed directly.
2) Karthik’s team will provision the 14-day burst pool and coordinate a warm-up window; please confirm preferred start date (we suggest 11/15 to align with the effective date).
3) Procurement: once you accept the DocuSign we’ll process order and priority provisioning.

For convenience I’ve added the HubSpot deal and DocuSign placeholders here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VC-4721 and https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/VC-4721-amendment

Claire — can you confirm: (A) acceptance in principle to the pricing above and (B) whether you’d like the burst pool to start on 2026-11-15 or an earlier pilot window (we can start as early as 2026-11-01 with a short smoke test)? If you confirm (A) and (B) I’ll mark the deal as committed and Kimberly will send the DocuSign.

Thanks — looking forward to getting VelociCart into the higher commit cadence.

—Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
